verdict.rationale: LM Studio now ships 'llmster', a headless daemon/CLI (no Electron GUI) explicitly positioned for servers/CI, and its 'lms' CLI plus on-demand model loading suggest a leaner path to inference than the full desktop app, addressing user complaints about the 'chonky Electron UI' requiring a full app to be running. However, there is no evidence of actual cold-start latency benchmarks or claims about binary size/startup speed, and independent commentary (lm-studio-comm-13) shows the lightweight daemon was a recent, still-imperfect addition rather than a mature, benchmarked fast-start runtime. missing for 10: quantitative cold-start/binary-size benchmarks, independent hands-on verification of llmster's startup speed vs the full app.
